title: Collective launch of printed gliders in PyBullet (6-DOF, quasi-steady per-surface aero, contacts)
does_not_establish: No observed schooling or collective behaviour: rigid printed gliders released together under an ASSUMED dispersion; no sensing, control, decision or population dynamics (ff-eco owns those); wake model is a straight horseshoe per fish.

checks.name: cross-check: 6-DOF static margin at the assembled key (dec+2) is 0.03-0.20 MAC (R2 trim rule targets 0.08)
control C1: aero-off range = V0 sqrt(2h/g) within 0.5% (PyBullet integrator)
control C2: symmetric launch stays symmetric (|y_land| < 1 mm, max roll < 0.5 deg)
control C3: widely spaced school without wake coupling = single fish (range within 1e-6 m, no contacts)
control C4: CG 12 mm aft of trim (behind NP) gives a larger pitch excursion than nominal
bound: nominal 6-DOF range between ballistic and (h+V0^2/2g)*15
control C6: wake coupling negligible at 2 m spacing (range change < 2 cm)
monotone (recorded): collision fraction does not increase from 0.25 m to 1.0 m spacing
